name: EQ: a three-band equalizer on every track, Low and High shelves on SWEEP and CONTOUR, a sweepable Mid on COLOR and SHAPE
description: A Track FX of model27 (the filter slot of notes/72, notes/73), on any track whose sound chose it (RETRIG + PITCH), after Volume + Dist: three bands, each -12 dB at 0, flat at the centre, +12 dB at the top. RETRIG + SWEEP is Low, a low shelf at 100 Hz; RETRIG + CONTOUR is High, a high shelf at 8 kHz, which starts at its centre (its start word, fltslot 0.8); RETRIG + COLOR is Mid, a bell of Q 1 whose centre RETRIG + SHAPE moves from 200 Hz through 1 kHz (its centre) to about 4.9 kHz. The Audio EQ Cookbook's biquads, the cuts the mirror of the boosts, on the EMAC with their coefficients from tables, worked out only when a value moves; a boost of a hot track clips at full scale. All four are real parameters of every machine: p-locks, LFO, velocity, Control All, CC 74 and 71 on Low and High. With every band at its centre the track passes untouched, bit for bit, and a sound that steps to EQ starts there. Since 0.2 the values are named EQ Low Gain, EQ High Gain, EQ Mid Gain and EQ Mid Freq, LOWG, HIGG, MIDG and MIDF as the LFO's destination (EQ Low, EQ High, EQ Mid, LOW, HIGH, MID, FREQ before). Since 0.3 the same sound in fewer instructions: High's coefficients over 2 up to about +9.2 dB (one doubling instead of two; the output within 6 LSB of 0.2's there, the same elsewhere), the words compared before they are clamped, a reset that leaves the states to the next block, four frames a turn of the loops.

uses.name: EQ
uses.why: an effect of the Track FX (the filter slot): called after Volume + Dist as (block, k 28 to k 31, track, triggered) on the tracks whose sound chose id 5

emulation.pattern: instructions per track and block, EQ's own code only (eq_process, the coefficients, eq_frames), on the OS 1.13 in tools/emu/test_fltslot.py's filter_cost (mcengine.py's counter): all six tracks on it, the stock machines playing, a state held for 8 blocks after 8 of warm-up (flat: every band at its centre; low, mid, high: that band alone, +6 dB, Mid at 2.2 kHz; all: Low and High +6 dB, Mid -6 dB at 450 Hz; boost: the same with High at +12 dB, over 4 (since 0.3); glide: the four values jumping every block, every band across its centre; silent: no note played, every band on), the maximum, and the block in which the tracks come to it from none (its reset and first block); the filter slot's own instructions apart

proof.why: tools/emu/test_fltslot.py builds the model from host and counts cost.emulation in cost_states (k 28 to k 31 of the blocks, in turn; silent plays no note), notes/73 §16

unchanged: every track whose sound has not chosen EQ
